what: Based on the viewer’s local time, only one of the day scene or night scene is set up for the same spot. By default it is night from 0:00 until before 6:00 (as in the original) and day otherwise. It is decided once on open (optionally re-checked every ‹every› seconds), and when it changes fx:hour (detail.mode = day|night) is fired. Like a workshop wall picture where a craftsperson sits by day and only the instrument sits under a desk lamp at night, the skin stays and only the picture board changes

options.from · to: Hours when night starts and ends (0~24), default 0 · 6 — if from is greater than to it wraps past midnight (22 · 5)
options.hour: Pin the time of day (0–23) — for demos and screenshots
options.every: Re-check every how many seconds, default 0 (once on open)

from.where: index.html .aa-hero (original head script isNightTime(0, 6) — between 0 and 6 o’clock it hides #day with display:none, otherwise it hides #night. Looks for the element every 100ms up to 5s, and acts only once)

note: Before the parts attach, fx.css sets up only the day panel. The consumer keeps the day and night panels the same size so they overlap in one spot. Switching the skin (light/dark theme) by time of day is daynight-theme-switch
